CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2024 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2024 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 3,071 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 12 benchmark sites in 5 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2024 to August 2024). These surveys captured 19 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 20 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 2,171 cards across 162 sites, with 7.8% showing evidence of mouse activity (169 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 692 transects across 153 sites (survey period: June 2024 to August 2024), detecting active burrows in 3.2% of transects (total: 101 active burrows).
